name: @aztec-avm-runtime/ct-host
description: TypeScript host for ct_writer.wasm — the CodeTracer .ct writer over a raw C ABI
//: NO DEPENDENCIES, and here that is a requirement rather than a preference.
ct_writer.wasm declares ZERO wasm imports — no WASI, no wasm-bindgen, no glue — so this
package owes the module nothing but a `WebAssembly.instantiate(bytes, {})` and a DataView
over its exported memory. That is the whole reason DD-7 chose a raw C ABI: the same host
code runs in Node and in a browser, which is what M27 needs and what a wasm-bindgen binding
It is deliberately a SEPARATE package from node-host. node-host is `avm.wasm` on node:wasi
and imports `node:wasi`; a browser cannot follow it there. Folding the writer into it would
put a Node-only import into the trace path for no reason.
tsc comes from the nix dev shell, and the Node APIs used are declared in types/, so a clean
checkout can type-check and run this package with no npm install at all — node-host's rule,
